arrendamiento_vivienda_afecto	Business-use share of home rent	usage_ratio_home_area	override=.	Deductible in proportion to the home's business-use floor area (Ley 35/2006 art. 29.2 and art. 28.1, rent of the home used for business).
comunidad_vivienda_afecto	Community/condo fees on home used for business	usage_ratio_home_area	override=.	Deductible in proportion to the home's floor area used for the business and to your ownership share in it; the 30% supplies factor does not apply (Ley 35/2006 art. 29.2, Reglamento IRPF art. 22.3, community fees of the home used for business).
ibi_vivienda_afecto	Property tax (IBI) on home used for business	usage_ratio_home_area	override=.	Deductible in proportion to the home's floor area used for the business and to your ownership share in it; the 30% supplies factor does not apply (Ley 35/2006 art. 29.2, Reglamento IRPF art. 22.3, property tax on the home used for business).
suministros_home_office_agua	Home-office water	usage_ratio_home_area	override=.	IRPF: where you use part of your habitual home for the activity, you deduct 30% of the ratio between the floor area used for the activity and the total floor area, unless you prove a higher or lower share (Ley 35/2006 art. 30.2, rule 5, letter b). IVA: the input cuota is deductible in proportion to the degree of use in the activity, without the 30% factor (Ley 37/1992 art. 95; TEAC resolution of 19 July 2023, RG 00/06654/2022).
